title: Bank Reconciliation Data Structures
description: Core data structures and formats for bank reconciliation processing

BankTransaction.description: Individual transaction entry from bank statement PDF
BankTransaction.source: Generated by pdf_service from PDF bank statement

fields.name: Debit/Credit
fields.validation: Must be numeric, positive for credit, negative for debit

BankTransaction.usage: Used for comparison against company transactions to identify discrepancies
notes: Transaction date and detail are preserved for display only
Only Debit/Credit field is used for matching logic
Sign indicates transaction type from bank's perspective

CompanyTransaction.description: Individual transaction entry from company financial records Excel
CompanyTransaction.source: Generated by excel_service from Excel company records

fields.name: Transaction Detail
fields.example: Fund Transfer Through RTGS from SBL to MCB BANK ISB

fields.name: Debit/Credit
fields.validation: Must be numeric, positive for credit, negative for debit

CompanyTransaction.usage: Used for comparison against bank transactions to identify discrepancies
notes: Transaction date and detail are preserved for display only
Only Debit/Credit field is used for matching logic
Sign indicates transaction type from company's perspective

DiscrepancyTransaction.description: Transaction present in one source but not the other with source attribution
DiscrepancyTransaction.source: Generated by reconciliation_service during discrepancy identification

fields.name: Debit/Credit
fields.validation: Inherited from source transaction, must be numeric

DiscrepancyTransaction.usage: Final output showing which transactions exist in one source but not the other
notes: FROM field indicates which source contains this transaction
All original transaction data is preserved
Used for frontend display of reconciliation results

ReconciliationSummary.description: Summary statistics about reconciliation process and results
ReconciliationSummary.source: Calculated by reconciliation_service and response helpers

fields.name: total_discrepancies
fields.description: Total discrepancies found after opposite pair removal

fields.name: opposite_pairs_removed
fields.description: Number of opposite sign pairs removed from discrepancy list

fields.name: processing_duration_ms
fields.description: Total processing time including PDF, Excel, and reconciliation

fields.name: concurrent_processing
fields.description: Whether PDF and Excel were processed concurrently

ReconciliationSummary.usage: Provides performance metrics and processing statistics
notes: Used for monitoring and performance analysis
Concurrent processing flag shows optimization usage

ReconciliationResult.description: Complete reconciliation response containing all processed data
ReconciliationResult.source: Generated by route handler combining all service outputs

fields.name: results
fields.validation: Must contain bank_statement, company_records, and discrepancies arrays

fields.name: discrepancies
fields.description: Unified discrepancy list with source attribution

ReconciliationResult.usage: Complete API response containing all reconciliation data
notes: Extends existing karwai endpoint response structure
Adds discrepancies field to existing results object
Maintains backward compatibility with existing frontend

data_flow.overview: Data flows from file upload through processing to final reconciliation results

stages.input: PDF bank statement + Excel company records
stages.processing: Validation and storage of uploaded files
Amount-based comparison and opposite pair removal

validation_rules.overview: Business rules and validation constraints for all data structures
transaction_matching: Transaction dates and descriptions do NOT affect matching
Matching is case-sensitive for exact amount equality
No fuzzy matching or tolerance-based comparison
opposite_sign_removal: Pairs removed when amounts are opposite (bank: +100, company: -100)
data_integrity: All entities require all defined fields (no nulls allowed)
Amounts must be numeric (int or float)
Dates must be valid date strings

scalability.maximum: 500 transactions per source (performance degraded but functional)

memory_management: Transaction lists kept in memory during processing only
Discrepancy lists streamed generation (no intermediate copies)

invalid_data_states.handling: Valid input, return empty discrepancy list with appropriate message
Return error and skip processing with clear error message
Graceful degradation to raw transaction data with error details

errors: Failed to process bank statement: Invalid PDF format
error_response_structure.message: Processing failed - Please check error details

implementation_notes.constitution_compliance: All data structures follow constitutional principles (accuracy, reliability, strict instruction following)
implementation_notes.developer_stack: Uses standard Python types, compatible with existing FastAPI/Pydantic models
implementation_notes.testing_support: All structures designed for comprehensive unit and integration testing
future_enhancements: Add result caching by input hash for performance
